fields.name: optional string — display name
fields.parentId: nullable string — parent node id for hierarchy
fields.metadata: JSON (default: {}) — ARBITRARY USER DATA — VISION 5D PROVENANCE TARGET

key_fields: children (wall, slab, door, window, etc. IDs)
position [x,y,z] — start point in world coords
WallNode.geometry_representation: Centerline-based with thickness. Supports straight and curved segments. Auto-mitering at junctions.

DoorNode.geometry_representation: Wall-mounted child. Position is center of door on wall face. Creates opening cutout in host wall.

WindowNode.geometry_representation: Wall-mounted child. Position is center on wall face. Creates opening cutout in host wall.

metadata_capability.vision5d_usage: Store all Vision 5D provenance: project_id, source_sha256, dxf_handles, source_layer, extraction_confidence, validation_status, unit, etc.
metadata_capability.constraint: Pascal does NOT rename, validate, or restrict metadata content. Vision 5D owns its metadata namespace ('vision5d' key).
